channel.title: Angor Blog - Latest Articles
channel.description: We're shaking up how Bitcoin crowdfunding works. Angor is a decentralized protocol, uniquely merging the security of Bitcoin with the transparency of Nostr. Investors funds are released in stages through time-lock contracts. Unspent funds can be recovered at any point, ensuring that investors maintain control and aligning the interests of investors and founders.

item.title: Boosting Bitcoin with Angor
item.description: This article explores how the Angor protocol enhances the economic efficiency of Bitcoin by introducing a decentralized peer-to-peer funding model. By unlocking dormant capital, reducing risk, and increasing transparency, Angor strengthens Bitcoin’s utility. It also leverages advanced features like Taproot and Schnorr to expand Bitcoin’s functionality beyond simple transactions.
